title: US inflation climbs above 4% for first time in three years as consumer spending stays resilient
summary: US inflation surged past 4% in May, primarily due to escalating energy costs linked to Middle East tensions. Despite rising living expenses, consumer spending showed resilience, buoyed by tax refunds and stock market gains.
